title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Role Profile & Job Description 
 Position Title: Design Manager Department: Engineering / Product Design & 
 Development Reports To: Head of Engineering / Director of Operations 
 Role Overview 
 The Design Manager is responsible for leading the design engineering function, 
 overseeing end-to-end design operations from initial concept through production 
 handoff. This role blends technical leadership, design validation, resource planning, 
 and cross-functional coordination with manufacturing, quality, and project 
 management teams to ensure deliverables meet functional, aesthetic, quality, and 
 budgetary requirements. 
 Core Key Result Areas (KRAs) & Responsibilities 
 Design Leadership & Project Execution: Lead, mentor, and allocate work across the 
 design engineering team to meet project milestones. Direct product design 
 workflows: concept modeling, detailed 3D CAD modeling, 2D drafting, assembly 
 generation, and Bill of Materials (BOM) creation. Establish and maintain 
 standardized design libraries, revision control, and Product Data Management 
 (PDM/PLM) protocols. 
 Design Validation & Compliance: 
 Conduct thorough Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) 
 reviews prior to tooling and fabrication release. Ensure engineering calculations, 
 tolerance stack-up analyses, and simulations (FEA/stress analysis) comply with 
 functional and safety standards. Verify that all technical documentation, engineering 
 change orders (ECOs), and production drawings adhere to applicable industry 
 standards (ISO, ASME, DIN). 
 Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination: 
 Collaborate closely with production, tooling, and fabrication units to resolve design- 
 related issues on the shop floor. Coordinate with vendors, prototype developers, and 
 component suppliers regarding material specifications, tooling feasibility, and sample 
 approvals. Support the quality control team by establishing inspection benchmarks, 
 critical-to-quality (CTQ) dimensions, and testing parameters. 
 Process Improvement & Team Development: 
 Implement best practices in CAD automation, modeling standards, and digital workflow 
 optimization. Drive continuous cost-reduction initiatives through value engineering 
 and material optimization. Conduct periodic technical training and performance 
 reviews for junior engineers and draftsmen. 
 Performance Indicators (KPIs ) 
 On-Time Release: Punctual delivery of design freezes, production drawings, and ECO 
 approvals. 
 First-Time-Right (FTR) Rate: Minimization of design revisions post-tooling or during 
 pilot production. 
 Cost & Weight Optimization: Measurable reductions in material usage or manufacturing 
 cycle time via value engineering. 
 Team Throughput: Effective task distribution and development of team capabilities.
